scope: Existing reconciliation only; local fixes and validation. No publication, deployment, funded transactions or new broad scan.

findings.title: Failed MCP tool results are committed as successful batch charges
findings.resolution: Returned MCP batch isError settles zero; successful batch and exact charging controls remain intact.

findings.title: First-seen accepted transaction can authorize a fresh exact request
findings.resolution: Both stores reject first-seen accepted artifacts atomically before creating a retry-adoptable attempt.

findings.title: Batch escrow can be locked until an attacker-chosen distant DAA score
findings.resolution: Shared client authorization enforces default 36000 DAA horizon for deposit, top-up and reuse and exposes the terms to the payer.

findings.title: Rate-scope overflow and profile-key collapse let distributed callers throttle new clients
findings.resolution: Native Worker bindings replace stateful overflow buckets, preserve canonical profile keys, and reject before payment-state calls.

findings.title: One REST source can fabricate a funded batch covenant
findings.resolution: The configured REST service remains trusted chain-evidence authority. Corrected the unsupported ownership claim; independent node verification remains a deployment trust decision. No deployed authority was verified.

findings.title: One REST upstream can forge all accepted-chain evidence
findings.resolution: The configured REST service remains trusted chain-evidence authority. Corrected the unsupported ownership claim; independent node verification remains a deployment trust decision. No deployed authority was verified.

findings.title: Exact payment identifiers are not durably reserved before protected work
findings.resolution: Atomic cross-scheme reservations, immutable identifier terms, failed-commit ordering and legacy admission quarantine prevent duplicate protected execution.

findings.title: Relative paidFetch URLs misidentify the payment origin
findings.resolution: Relative URLs resolve against browser location once; real 402/retry and origin-policy checks cover the canonical URL.

findings.title: Shared overflow quota lets distributed callers deny new clients
findings.resolution: Native Worker bindings replace stateful overflow buckets, preserve canonical profile keys, and reject before payment-state calls.

findings.title: Hosted exact-payment expiry blocks durable replay and response recovery
findings.resolution: Authenticated fully matching durable accepted/staged recovery crosses expiry gates; fresh expired requests still fail.

findings.title: Prepared escrow deposits can exceed the amount approved by the payer
findings.resolution: Prepared genesis amount must equal the payer-approved amount before funding or persistence.

findings.title: REST-asserted lineage can corrupt the durable additive exact head
findings.resolution: The configured REST service remains trusted chain-evidence authority. Corrected the unsupported ownership claim; independent node verification remains a deployment trust decision. No deployed authority was verified.

findings.title: Failed batch handlers can permanently block merchant claims
findings.resolution: Trusted operator-confirmed outcomes commit without payer retry; ambiguous throws remain pending and charge limits/staged-result immutability remain enforced.

findings.title: One REST source can attest a nonexistent exact payment
findings.resolution: The configured REST service remains trusted chain-evidence authority. Corrected the unsupported ownership claim; independent node verification remains a deployment trust decision. No deployed authority was verified.

findings.title: Lost identifier leases can execute two exact handlers
findings.resolution: Atomic cross-scheme reservations, immutable identifier terms, failed-commit ordering and legacy admission quarantine prevent duplicate protected execution.

findings.title: A compromised chain API can forge settlement evidence
findings.resolution: The configured REST service remains trusted chain-evidence authority. Corrected the unsupported ownership claim; independent node verification remains a deployment trust decision. No deployed authority was verified.

findings.title: One REST source can attest nonexistent exact and batch payments
findings.resolution: The configured REST service remains trusted chain-evidence authority. Corrected the unsupported ownership claim; independent node verification remains a deployment trust decision. No deployed authority was verified.

findings.title: Conflicting standard-native payments can leave unbounded pending settlement attempts
findings.resolution: Transactional cap of 64 pending exact/batch attempts, trusted rejection and accepted completion paths prevent unbounded admission while preserving ambiguity evidence.

findings.title: Low-value batch charges can permanently duplicate attacker-inflated channel state
findings.resolution: Stored channel state includes explicit protocol fields only; large unknown payer fields are excluded from channels and journals.

findings.title: Vendored SDK verifier accepts an unbounded upstream response
findings.resolution: Streaming hashing and download enforce 256 MiB, overall deadline, HTTPS redirects and cleanup on failure.

findings.title: Rate-scope overflow and profile-key collapse let distributed callers throttle new clients
findings.resolution: Native Worker bindings replace stateful overflow buckets, preserve canonical profile keys, and reject before payment-state calls.

findings.title: Live-proof key files trust unsafe pre-existing paths
findings.resolution: Key reads enforce private owner/mode, regular file, size and no-follow checks; private directory and exclusive creation cover all reference key paths.

findings.title: Site build follows publishable symlinks outside the repository
findings.resolution: All site file reads/copies/hashes resolve to regular inputs contained in the repository.

findings.title: Admin bearer token permits unrestricted online guessing
findings.resolution: Configured tokens require 64 hex characters and native admin rate admission precedes authentication. Random generation is documented; format does not prove entropy and no deployed secret was checked.

findings.title: Historical release schemas resolve dependencies from the mutable active release
findings.resolution: Historical schema dependency mutability is documented in an external erratum; immutable historical bytes are preserved. Alpha.11 uses release-local schemas.

findings.title: A predictable shared temporary path lets a local attacker redirect release output
findings.resolution: Removed unused predictable shared temporary output redirection; dry-run output goes to stdout.

findings.title: Raw channel private key is propagated to unrelated client adapters
findings.resolution: Raw key custody is intentional for same-process reference adapters; key removal would break their signer/top-up paths. Untrusted adapters require signer-owned custody and no raw key.

findings.title: Private-endpoint checks accept public DNS names with numeric prefixes
findings.resolution: Shared complete IPv4 parsing rejects numeric-prefix DNS names and invalid octets in all browser/preview checks.

findings.title: PNN browser check logs credential-bearing endpoint URLs
findings.resolution: Final JSON, retry errors and top-level failures use the shared sanitizer; independent review exercised credential-bearing failure output.

findings.title: Paid callers can exhaust durable storage with permanent exact settlement journals
findings.resolution: Native SQLite size stops new admission at 512 MiB with recovery headroom; replay and admitted completion remain available. Journals are retained rather than unsafely pruned.

findings.title: Public status routes can saturate the settlement Durable Object
findings.resolution: Native pre-state admission plus query-independent 15 second cache protects status routes.

findings.title: Alpha.1–10 release locks do not bind source provenance fields
findings.resolution: External erratum explains that old content hashes do not authenticate excluded provenance; historical lock bytes preserved.

findings.title: Frozen Alpha.1–10 schemas resolve dependencies through mutable active routes
findings.resolution: Historical schema dependency mutability is documented in an external erratum; immutable historical bytes are preserved. Alpha.11 uses release-local schemas.

findings.title: Covenant fixture source escapes the validation root
findings.resolution: Fixture JSON and source reads enforce root containment, regular files and a 2 MiB cap; traversal/link/size and valid-root controls pass.

findings.title: Proof tooling loads executable modules from configuration
findings.resolution: Operator-selected proof adapter modules are executable configuration by design; no untrusted configuration authority was established.

findings.title: Monitoring routes bypass limits and load payment state
findings.resolution: Native pre-state admission plus query-independent 15 second cache protects status routes.

findings.title: Historical immutable release metadata installs mutable current-alpha packages
findings.resolution: External erratum directs reproducible installation to exact versions in historical packages.json; historical alpha selector strings remain unchanged.

findings.title: CI executes mutable GitHub Action tags with implicit token permissions
findings.resolution: Both workflows pin official version-tag commits, set contents:read and disable persisted checkout credentials.

findings.title: CI executes mutable GitHub Action tags
findings.resolution: Both workflows pin official version-tag commits, set contents:read and disable persisted checkout credentials.

findings.title: Refund signer can authorize an unchecked high-fee transaction
findings.resolution: Custom refund builders are trusted signing authority; the reference builder enforces its fixed-fee construction. An untrusted-builder API would require transaction-intent verification.

findings.title: Rate-scope overflow lets distributed callers throttle unrelated new clients
findings.resolution: Native Worker bindings replace stateful overflow buckets, preserve canonical profile keys, and reject before payment-state calls.
